paragraphs: Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Shimon.

He is mentioned in [Kohelet Rabbah](https://www.sefaria.org/Kohelet_Rabbah.2.5), speaking to Rabbi Abba bar Kahana, and also in Tanchuma, Tavo. Yuchasin cites Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Shimon with the form כרבי, while Seder HaDorot writes, “I have not found it.” [Pesikta Rabbati 21, in the section on the Ten Commandments](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesikta_Rabbati_21), does have: “Rabbi Yannai, son of Rabbi Shimon son of R' Yannai, said to him (to Rabbi Levi).” Hyman says that the word ברבי as written in Yuchasin has lost its abbreviation marks; he reads it as בר׳ ינאי, “son of R' Yannai.”[^1]

notes.text: Hyman first quotes כרבי, but later calls the form ברבי.
